description: This file contains controller functions for handling user messages in a Strapi-based API, including retrieving multiple messages, fetching a single message, toggling read status, and deleting messages.

methods.name: getMyMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all messages for the current user, limited to all entries.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Fetches a single message by ID for the current user.

methods.name: toggleRead
methods.description: Toggles the read status of a specific message.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a specific message for the current user.
